propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation does not explicitly state that a blocked ticket represents a completed review cycle and requires no further agent action until dependencies are resolved.

Agents lack clear guidance that rebar review-plan --force is a human-operator-only escape hatch and should not be used based on vague instructions, creating risk of repeated forced reviews that silently invalidate attestations.

The skill must document that blocked/not-yet-claimable tickets (status closed/idea/blocked or open with unclosed dependencies) automatically re-enter the queue via rebar ready when blockers close, requiring no agent retry.
Documentation must reinforce that a series of individually-plausible forced reviews should not be treated as collectively acceptable policy.
